$comment: Completion bar for #23: with CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder skipped signing, so the arm64 app kept only the linker's ad-hoc signature on the main binary with no sealed resources. codesign --verify failed ('code has no resources but signature indicates they must be present'), which a quarantined download reports as 'is damaged and can't be opened'. Fix: build.mac identity '-' (ad-hoc sign the whole bundle) and hardenedRuntime false (only matters for notarization; ad-hoc + hardened runtime risks library-validation launch failures). Criterion 1 fails on main (identity unset, hardenedRuntime true). 2 fails on main (README has no quarantine fallback). Verified by hand on macOS 26.6.2 arm64: codesign --verify --deep --strict passes, a quarantined copy of the .dmg's app is rejected by Gatekeeper only for 'Notary Ticket Missing' (the Open Anyway flow), and the app launches (see PR).
